final: WITH account_totals AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS account_total, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), shares AS (SELECT account_id, region, account_total, transaction_count, 1.0 * account_total / SUM(account_total) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS share FROM account_totals) SELECT account_id, region, account_total, transaction_count, share FROM shares ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC, account_id LIMIT 10
